Your text stays on this device. It's kept only while this tab is open, so a refresh won't lose your work.

faq.a: Using your browser's built-in language rules, so “don't” is one word, hyphenated words like “well-known” are counted the way most editors count them, and languages written without spaces (like Japanese or Chinese) are split sensibly.

faq.q: Do emoji count as one character?
faq.a: Yes. 👍🏽 or a flag counts as one character here, the way you see it. Some platforms count them as two; the byte count shows what a database or API will store.
At 238 words per minute, the average silent reading speed for adults in English. Speaking time uses 150 words per minute, a comfortable presentation pace.

faq.q: Why does the SMS count say Unicode?
faq.a: Texts that only use the basic GSM alphabet fit 160 characters per message. One emoji or a curly quote switches the whole message to Unicode, which fits only 70.
